description:
Nestled on a generous c. 2,700 sq.m. site in the picturesque countryside of Garryhundon, Milford, Co. Carlow, this beautifully maintained detached bungalow offers the perfect balance of peaceful country living and excellent accessibility. Surrounded by rolling countryside and scenic views, this highly sought-after location is renowned for its tranquil setting while remaining just 4 minutes from the M9 (Junction 6), 5 minutes from Leighlinbridge, and under 10 minutes from Carlow Town, providing easy access to schools, shops, restaurants, and all everyday amenities. 
Presented in excellent condition throughout, the property is ready for immediate occupation and offers bright, spacious accommodation designed for modern family living. At the heart of the home is a superb open-plan kitchen, dining and living area, creating a welcoming space for everyday life and entertaining alike. A separate sitting room, complete with an inset solid fuel stove, provides a cosy retreat during the cooler months.
The accommodation comprises four bedrooms, including two bedrooms with en-suite, together with a stylish main family bathroom, offering comfort and convenience for modern family living.
Externally, the property continues to impress with its expansive gardens, attractive patio area, and a number of charming seating areas that have been thoughtfully positioned to make the most of the peaceful surroundings. Whether enjoying a morning coffee or entertaining guests on a summer evening, the outdoor space offers a wonderful extension of the home.
Further enhancing its appeal, the property benefits from 10 solar panels, contributing to improved energy efficiency and lower running costs. 
Combining generous living space, a picturesque rural setting, modern energy efficiency and outstanding convenience to Carlow Town and the M9, this is a rare opportunity to acquire a superb family home in one of South Carlow's most desirable residential locations.
